task1_simulation_test.critical_finding: git-privilege-guard scope is NARROWER than spec 5.2.4 R4.3 intent. Spec section 5.2.4 explicitly notes: 'b5d447e was committed in a regular Claude Code session on 2026-04-21 17:45 UTC — no overnight state file present — so this hook was structurally inert at the moment that mattered.' The G4 implementation kept the hook overnight-only with the justification 'Interactive sessions where the human is online and supervising every tool call do not need this guard'. This is a defensible design choice but contradicts the spec's explicit reasoning. NEW GAP for next session to decide.
